1.consolidated_definition: Planta epifita, con ramas que cuelgan hasta 4 m, de flores solitarias, pequeñas, de color blanco, y baya globosa con semillas negras. Cactaceae, Rhipsalis cassutha.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Epiphytic plant with hanging branches up to 4 m long, bearing solitary small white flowers and a globular berry with black seeds. Cactaceae, Rhipsalis cassutha.
